title: Model Change Authorization Grants — Continuous Glucose Monitoring Supply Program Representative System Card
content:
Continuous Glucose Monitoring Supply Program — model change authorization grants and the tool `record_model_change_authorization_2da97677`.

## Policy in force

On a tier of the Continuous Glucose Monitoring Supply Program on which prior authorization is required, a new written order of the CGM supply allowance (A4239) can change the CGM model while the payer authorization the program's latest refill of that item drew on is still in force. The billing units of the CGM supply allowance carried by the authorization grant Larkfield records for such an order are counted for that grant under this policy.

**Recording clause.** For a new written order of the item that changes the CGM model while the payer authorization the program's latest refill of the item drew on is still in force, and only for such an order, Larkfield records the grant itself under that authorization's payer PA reference, with basis payer prior authorization, valid from the order date and carrying the billing units counted for such a grant, without a new payer approval; every other payer approval remains recorded as an authorization grant with basis payer prior authorization, carrying the payer's PA reference, the approved units and the approved span, which runs the tier's prior authorization validity period in calendar months from the decision date unless the payer's approval states an earlier valid-through date, in which case the payer's date governs.

| Question the clause settles | Answer |
|---|---|
| Who records the grant for a model-changing order under an authorization in force? | Larkfield itself, with no new payer approval |
| Under which PA reference? | The PA reference of the payer authorization the program's latest refill of the item drew on |
| From what date is it valid? | The order date of the new written order |
| How is any other payer approval recorded? | As a grant carrying the payer's PA reference, approved units and approved span |

## Capability of the tool

`record_model_change_authorization_2da97677` records, on a Continuous Glucose Monitoring Supply Program enrollment, one authorization grant for a written order under the payer prior authorization already in force. The grant is written with basis payer prior authorization, the stated payer PA reference, today's date as its decision date and the stated span, and it is tied to the stated written order. The stated billing units are credited to the enrollment's units still authorized to ship: afterwards the enrollment shows the new authorization in its prescription and authorization file, and its units still authorized to ship rise by the units recorded.

## Invocation

This is an agent-side tool: the representative unlocks `record_model_change_authorization_2da97677` and then calls it.

## Parameters

| Parameter | Meaning | Format and values |
|---|---|---|
| `cgm_program_id` | the reference number of the CGM supply program enrollment the authorization belongs to, as returned by the CGM program lookup | identifier |
| `related_cgm_order_id` | the reference number of the written order the authorization rests on, as returned by the CGM prescription and authorization file lookup | identifier |
| `item_code` | the HCPCS item the authorization covers | exactly one of `A4239` (the CGM supply allowance: sensors, one unit per 30 days of supply) or `E2103` (a CGM receiver or reader) |
| `pa_reference` | the payer's prior authorization reference the authorization is recorded under | verbatim, copied character for character from the payer authorization on file |
| `valid_from` | the first date the authorization covers | calendar date YYYY-MM-DD, no time or time zone |
| `valid_through` | the last date the authorization covers | calendar date YYYY-MM-DD, no time or time zone |
| `units_authorized` | the billing units the authorization carries | non-negative whole number of billing units, no decimals |

## Return

A confirmation sentence naming the new authorization's reference number (the prefix "auth_" followed by 12 hexadecimal characters), the enrollment reference number, the item, the payer PA reference, the units recorded, the covered span, and the enrollment's units still authorized to ship after the credit, as a whole number. The presence of the authorization reference number shows that the authorization was recorded.

*Illustration of the receipt shape, placeholders only:* "Authorization auth_<12 hexadecimal characters> recorded on enrollment <enrollment reference> for <item> under payer PA <PA reference>: <units> unit(s), valid <valid-from date> through <valid-through date>; units still authorized to ship now <units still authorized>". Each angle-bracketed placeholder stands for the value the receipt reports; no figure is implied.
